{
  "subtype": "faceted_decomposition",
  "concept": "learner_needs_and_pain_points",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "hands_on_exploration_need",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Captures the need for physical/hands-on/lab/manipulative experiences -- a genuine aspect of learner needs and a distinct category of pain point."
    },
    {
      "name": "instructional_delivery_quality",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Represents pain points about how instruction is delivered (interactivity, pacing, feedback, live discussion) -- a constitutive aspect of learner needs regarding teaching."
    },
    {
      "name": "attention_focus_sustainability",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Covers cognitive/engagement pain points (attention span, screen fatigue, comprehension loss) -- a legitimate aspect of learner needs during remote learning."
    },
    {
      "name": "household_equity_barrier",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Captures access/equity barriers (materials, tech, parental support) -- a constitutive category of learner pain points, distinct from instructional or cognitive facets."
    },
    {
      "name": "peer_interaction_loss",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Represents social/collaborative needs and their loss -- a distinct constitutive aspect of learner needs."
    },
    {
      "name": "subject_specific_challenge",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Captures subject-dependent needs (labs, literacy groups, studio, ensemble). Partially overlaps with hands_on_exploration_need (science_lab, art_studio) and peer_interaction (ensemble/community), cross-cutting existing facets rather than being cleanly orthogonal."
    }
  ],
  "facet_columns": [
    "hands_on_exploration_need",
    "instructional_delivery_quality",
    "attention_focus_sustainability",
    "household_equity_barrier",
    "peer_interaction_loss",
    "subject_specific_challenge"
  ],
  "non_facet_columns": [],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.65,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.85,
  "rationale": "All six columns are genuine constitutive facets of learner needs and pain points -- each names an aspect OF the concept (hands-on experience, instructional delivery, cognitive engagement, equity/access, social interaction, subject specificity) rather than an external predictor, cause, or restatement of the whole. Coverage of the concept's main aspects is strong. However, mutual exclusivity is weakened because subject_specific_challenge is a cross-cutting facet whose values overlap other columns (science_lab_dependent overlaps hands_on_exploration; art_studio_community_needed / performance_ensemble_required overlap peer_interaction and hands-on facets), meaning the same underlying pain point can register under multiple columns. This categorization-vs-aspect overlap prevents a clean MECE partition despite good exhaustiveness."
}
